notes: Netaji Subhas-ICAR International Fellowship is a central Government of India scheme administered by ICAR (Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare). Like MEXT/GKS/Fulbright/DAAD-type national schemes, it has no single attached host institution or named supervising professor on the official scheme pages; fellows are placed across ICAR-AU institutions at award time. https://www.icar.gov.in returned repeated transport errors during research and could not be opened, but the scheme classification (national/government, no attached institution) makes it not_applicable.
